question: Is the imaging plan ready to implement into the paper?
verdict: The DESIGN is ready. EXECUTION is blocked on disk, and no results exist yet.
ready: Cohort closed and reproducible: 59 patients, 80 studies, 193 confirmed pairs, 217 series
Same-acquisition confirmation done from real DICOM tags (234/234 fetched, 0 errors)
PRESPECIFICATION_IMAGING.md v2 fixed before segmentation: unit of inference declared (patient, not pair), magnitude-led framing, 10% kill criterion, 3 endpoints
Endpoint 2 feasibility verified: 59/59 patients have primary-tumour RNA-seq; NPR1 and the 100-receptor floor-passing panel all present in the matrix
Prior-art positioning done (26 verified DOIs); Introduction claims narrowed to what is defensible
Guardrail halt of the v1 endpoint is itself a reportable result and needs no further compute

disk.breakdown: torch+TotalSegmentator ~3.0, weights ~0.35, largest single series 0.94, masks ~0.05
disk.note: staged download does NOT solve this; the software stack alone exceeds free space
options: add a remote compute target (list_compute currently returns none)
run segmentation elsewhere and bring back masks/volumes only

blocking.unpinned_model: TotalSegmentator not installed or version-pinned. PyPI current 2.18.0, nnU-Net 2.8.1. Prespec requires weights hash logged; an unpinned run is discarded.
blocking.no_results: Zero segmentations have run. Endpoints 1, 2 and 3 have no data. Nothing about volumes or association stability can enter the manuscript yet.

runtime_estimate_if_unblocked.note: 8 GiB RAM caps concurrency; no GPU

what_can_go_into_the_paper_today: Methods: cohort derivation, header audit, same-acquisition confirmation
Results: the v1 endpoint halt with its funnel (35 -> 31 -> 17 -> 5) and the contrast cross-tab
Discussion: prior-art positioning, the narrowed claim (reconstruction, not acquisition)
what_cannot: the retitle, which presumes a direction the data has not shown
